versions.changelog:
- Initial release defining the Gitea multi-role collaboration workflow.
- Clearly outlines role responsibilities for Implementers and Coordinators, including cycle steps and notification protocols.
- Describes communication conventions to minimize group chat noise and centralize work in issues/PRs.
- Details loop control and recommended cron scheduling for both roles.
- Includes guidance for adapting this workflow to various types of studios (e.g., game, documentation, product).
- Excludes Gitea API usage and deployment instructions; focuses solely on process and collaboration structure.
